% Right to left: Arabic in Amiri (joining, marks), Hebrew, mixed digits,
% TeXXeT's \beginR...\endR, a word without strong characters after an
% Arabic one (the font's last script sets its direction).
\catcode`\{=1 \catcode`\}=2 \catcode`\#=6
\hsize=300pt \vsize=600pt \parindent=0pt \baselineskip=18pt \tolerance=10000
\parfillskip=0pt plus 1fil \TeXXeTstate=1
\font\ar="[Amiri-Regular.ttf]:script=arab" at 12pt
\font\he="Libertinus Serif:script=hebr" at 11pt
\font\la="[lmroman10-regular]" at 10pt
\la English \beginR\ar مرحبا بالعالم، هذا نص عربي ١٢٣ 456.\endR\ more.\par
\beginR\ar السلام عليكم ورحمة الله\endR\par
\beginR\he שלום עולם, זה טקסט בעברית.\endR\par
\ar نص 123 ... \la 123 (ab)\par
\end
